points.en: HPI measures deprivation in quality of life.
points.hi: HPI measures deprivation in quality of life.

points.en: It focuses on three dimensions: longevity, knowledge, and standard of living.
points.hi: It focuses on three dimensions: longevity, knowledge, and standard of living.

points.en: Unlike HDI, which measures progress, HPI measures the shortfall in human development.
points.hi: Unlike HDI, which measures progress, HPI measures the shortfall in human development.

explanation.en: These are the three pillars used to calculate the Human Poverty Index.
explanation.hi: These are the three pillars used to calculate the Human Poverty Index.

answer.en: It measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions.
answer.hi: It measures the extent of deprivation in basic human development dimensions.

misconception.en: HPI is the same as the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI).
misconception.hi: HPI is the same as the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI).

correction.en: HPI was the predecessor to the MPI; MPI is now the standard used by UNDP.
correction.hi: HPI was the predecessor to the MPI; MPI is now the standard used by UNDP.

fiveFacts.en: HPI was introduced by the UNDP in 1997.
fiveFacts.hi: HPI was introduced by the UNDP in 1997.

fiveFacts.en: It highlights the 'poverty of choices' rather than just income poverty.
fiveFacts.hi: It highlights the 'poverty of choices' rather than just income poverty.

fiveFacts.en: HPI-1 was for developing countries, HPI-2 for selected OECD countries.
fiveFacts.hi: HPI-1 was for developing countries, HPI-2 for selected OECD countries.

fiveFacts.en: It was replaced by the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) in 2010.
fiveFacts.hi: It was replaced by the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) in 2010.

fiveFacts.en: It focuses on the exclusion of people from social and economic life.
fiveFacts.hi: It focuses on the exclusion of people from social and economic life.

threeTraps.en: Assuming HPI is based solely on income levels.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming HPI is based solely on income levels.

threeTraps.en: Confusing HPI with the Human Development Index (HDI).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing HPI with the Human Development Index (HDI).

threeTraps.en: Thinking HPI is still the primary metric used in current UNDP reports.
